title: Earliest Finish Time for Land and Water Rides I
summary: Given the start times and durations for land and water rides, determine the earliest possible time at which a tourist can finish both rides, one from each category.
statement: Given the start times and durations for land and water rides, determine the earliest possible time at which a tourist can finish both rides, one from each category. The tourist can start each ride at its earliest possible time or any later time, and must immediately begin the second ride upon finishing the first.
constraints: Choose exactly one land ride and one water ride in either order.
A ride may start at its listed earliest time or later, and the second begins as soon as both it and the tourist are ready.
Return the earliest possible completion time.
hints: Enumerate one ride from each category.
For land first, water starts at max(land finish, water availability).
The minimum across pairs and orders is globally earliest.
editorial: The minimum across pairs and orders is globally earliest.

tests.explanation: Taking the first land ride at two then water at six finishes at nine.
Water first finishes at three, then land finishes at eight.
